name: @sunstack/sdk
description: Typed TypeScript access to the Sunstack engine: load, check and run configurations

scripts.build: pnpm run generate && pnpm run build:native && pnpm run build:typescript
scripts.lint: oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --type-aware --type-check --tsconfig tsconfig.json --max-warnings 0 src scripts tests examples
scripts.format: oxfmt src scripts tests examples package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json .oxlintrc.json README.md npm
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts tests examples package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json .oxlintrc.json README.md npm
